definitions.BCC-1: Completeness — all ten realization units physically exist and are CERTIFIED.
definitions.BCC-2: Predecessor units frozen-clean — no certified unit mutated (reuse by reference).
definitions.BCC-3: Readiness discharged — the band readiness criteria BRC-1…8 all PASS.
definitions.BCC-4: Dependency closure — downward-only, acyclic; no forward/upward dependency.
definitions.BCC-5: Consistency — the UIMM integration closes over the ten realized units.
definitions.BCC-6: Reuse integrity — no EL-1/prior-unit concept redefined; no new primitive.
definitions.BCC-7: Discipline conformance per unit — UCIC-001 + CCE + determinism.
definitions.BCC-8: Governance records — all evidence bundles + completion reports present (traceable).
